karty.priklad: Mewn dau fis, bydd hen neuadd yr ysgol yn ailagor fel theatr.
karty.priklad_cs: In two months the old school hall will reopen as a theatre.
karty.mnemo: ail (second, again) + agor (to open).

extra.pozn: sentence from the article on p. 115 (gap-fill exercise)

karty.priklad: Rhaid i chi anadlu'n ddwfn am eiliad a byddwch chi'n hollol iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: You must breathe deeply for a second and you'll be absolutely fine (dwfn → [dd]wfn after 'n).
karty.mnemo: anadl = breath: ANNA'D (ANAD-lu) better breathe deeply before the high dive.

extra.pozn: sentence from the dialogue Rhoi gwaed (p. 111)

karty.priklad: Dw i wrth fy modd yn arogli bara ffres.
karty.priklad_cs: I love the smell of fresh bread (literally: smelling fresh bread).
karty.mnemo: AROMA → AROGLi.

extra.pozn: arogl = smell, scent (L18); bara ffres is from p. 105, the sentence is my own; the southern colloquial gwynto (ma fe'n gwynto) is outside the coursebook

karty.priklad: Blasodd hi'r gacen a gwenodd hi.
karty.priklad_cs: She tasted the cake and smiled (cacen → [g]acen after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: blas = taste: a BLAST (BLAS-u) of flavour on your tongue.

extra.pozn: blas = taste (L12), blasus = tasty; own example

karty.priklad: Curodd Cymru Loegr neithiwr.
karty.priklad_cs: Wales beat England last night (Lloegr → [L]oegr, the object after the subject).
karty.mnemo: 'CURRY, oh!' (CUR-o) – the delivery driver knocks on the door.

extra.pozn: curo'r drws = to knock on the door (card 0374), curo dwylo = to clap (L17); own example

karty.priklad: Dylwn i fod wedi chwynnu'r ardd.
karty.priklad_cs: I should have weeded the garden (gardd → ardd after 'r, feminine: the g drops).
karty.mnemo: chwyn (weeds) + -u = to weed.

extra.pozn: modelled on Dylwn i fod wedi… (p. 105), the sentence is my own

karty.cs: to suffer; to put up with
karty.priklad: Ro'n i'n dioddef o boen cefn am fisoedd.
karty.priklad_cs: I suffered from back pain for months (poen → [b]oen after o; misoedd → [f]isoedd after am).
karty.mnemo: Plants suffer in the drought and DIE OFF (DI-ODD-ef).

extra.pozn: dioddef o = to suffer from (soft mutation after o); dioddefwr = victim, sufferer (outside the coursebook); Robin Radio: Dw i'n dioddef o ddiffyg cwsg (p. 116, example on the cwsg card); own sentence

karty.priklad: Ddylen ni ddim bod wedi gwastraffu cymaint o fwyd.
karty.priklad_cs: We shouldn't have wasted so much food (bwyd → [f]wyd after o).
karty.mnemo: From English waste: gwastraff (waste, rubbish) + -u.

extra.pozn: gwastraff = waste, rubbish (L2); modelled on Ddylwn i ddim bod wedi… (p. 107), the sentence is my own

karty.cs: to venture; to dare, to risk
karty.priklad: Penderfynais i ddod yn ôl yma a mentro dechrau busnes.
karty.priklad_cs: I decided to come back here and take the plunge and start a business (dod → [dd]od after penderfynais i).
karty.mnemo: menter (venture, enterprise): your MENTOR (MENTRo) dares you to take the risk.

extra.pozn: mentrus = adventurous (L7), menter = enterprise (L16); sentence from the article on p. 115 (gap-fill exercise)

karty.priklad: Mae'r ŵyn bach yn pori yn y cae.
karty.priklad_cs: The little lambs are grazing in the field.
karty.mnemo: Sheep graze and you PORE (PORI) over websites – both are pori.

extra.pozn: pori'r we = to browse the web; gweld ŵyn bach yn pori is from p. 105, the sentence is adapted

karty.priklad: Ddylet ti ddim bod wedi rhentu'r tŷ.
karty.priklad_cs: You shouldn't have rented the house.
karty.mnemo: From English rent.

extra.pozn: sentence from p. 107

karty.priklad: Sylweddolais i fod y drws ar glo.
karty.priklad_cs: I realised the door was locked (bod → [f]od after sylweddolais i).
karty.mnemo: sylw (attention) + -eddoli: your attention finally clicks.

extra.pozn: sylw = attention (L1); own example

karty.priklad: Mae fy ystafell wely i'n anniben iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: My bedroom is really untidy.
karty.mnemo: ANNIE and BEN (ANNI-BEN) share a very untidy bedroom.

extra.pozn: opposite: taclus = tidy (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n awyddus iawn i ddysgu Cymraeg.
karty.priklad_cs: She's very keen to learn Welsh (dysgu → [dd]ysgu after i).
karty.mnemo: awydd = desire, eagerness.

extra.pozn: awyddus i + soft mutation; own example

karty.priklad: Roedd y gweinydd yn gwrtais iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The waiter was very polite (cwrtais → [g]wrtais after yn).
karty.mnemo: From English courteous.

extra.pozn: anghwrtais = impolite; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r llyn yn ddwfn iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The lake is very deep (dwfn → [dd]wfn after yn).
karty.mnemo: A DOVE (DWF-n) dives into deep water.

extra.pozn: dyfnder = depth; anadlu'n ddwfn = to breathe deeply (p. 111); own example

karty.priklad: Does dim byd yn well na bath poeth moethus.
karty.priklad_cs: Nothing beats a luxurious hot bath.
karty.mnemo: MOTHS (MOETH-us) eat holes in your luxurious cashmere.

extra.pozn: moeth = luxury; bath poeth moethus is from p. 105, the sentence is my own

karty.priklad: Ond dw i'n nerfus iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: But I'm really nervous.
karty.mnemo: From English nervous.

extra.pozn: sentence from Ymarfer – Perswadio (p. 108)

karty.priklad: Mae'r drws ffrynt ar glo.
karty.priklad_cs: The front door is locked (clo → [g]lo after ar).
karty.mnemo: ar (on) + clo (lock): it's on the lock.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Pwy sy'n curo'r drws yr amser yma o'r nos?
karty.priklad_cs: Who's knocking on the door at this time of night?
karty.mnemo: curo (to knock) + 'r drws (the door).

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Dw i wrth fy modd yn hel atgofion gyda hen ffrind.
karty.priklad_cs: I love reminiscing with an old friend.
karty.mnemo: hel (to gather) + atgofion (memories): gathering up memories.

extra.pozn: hel = to gather, to collect; from p. 105, the sentence is completed

sever.priklad: Dw i wrth fy modd yn hel atgofion efo hen ffrind.
sever.priklad_cs: I love reminiscing with an old friend.

karty.priklad: Mae'r gegin ar y llawr gwaelod.
karty.priklad_cs: The kitchen is on the ground floor (cegin → [g]egin after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: llawr (floor, storey) + gwaelod (bottom): the very bottom floor of an Arctic research station.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the arall box (purple); grammatically a masculine noun (like llawr); the coursebook gives no plural; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r ysgol o fewn milltir i'r tŷ.
karty.priklad_cs: The school is within a mile of the house.
karty.mnemo: mewn = in: o fewn = from within.

extra.pozn: o fewn wythnos = within a week; own example

karty.cs: the far end; in the end (yn y pen draw)
karty.priklad: Ond gorffennodd y stori'n hapus yn y pen draw!
karty.priklad_cs: But the story ended happily in the end!
karty.mnemo: pen (end) + draw (over there): right over there at the very end.

extra.pozn: yn y pen draw = in the end, ultimately; pen draw'r stryd = the far end of the street; sentence from p. 106

karty.priklad: Mae rhywbeth o'i le ar y car.
karty.priklad_cs: There's something wrong with the car.
karty.mnemo: rhywbeth (something) + o'i le (out of its place; lle → le after ei).

extra.pozn: = rhywbeth yn bod; literally something not in its place (lle → le after ei = its)

karty.priklad: Mae fy rhieni'n byw mewn tŷ pâr.
karty.priklad_cs: My parents live in a semi-detached house.
karty.mnemo: tŷ (house) + pâr (pair): a house made for a pair – two igloos joined at the hip.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the arall box (purple); grammatically a masculine noun (like tŷ), pl. tai pâr (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n cytuno'n hollol.
karty.priklad_cs: I completely agree.
karty.mnemo: holl = all, whole: yn hollol = wholly, completely.

extra.pozn: Yn hollol! = Exactly!; byddwch chi'n hollol iawn (p. 111); own example

karty.priklad: Dyna'n union beth ddwedais i.
karty.priklad_cs: That's exactly what I said (dweud → [dd]wedais).
karty.mnemo: union = exact, straight: like a UNION, the two halves meet exactly.

extra.pozn: own example

sever.pozn: north: be instead of beth (L9), deud instead of dweud (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Dw i eisiau cyngor am fy nghwsg.
karty.priklad_cs: I want some advice about my sleep (cwsg → [ngh]wsg after fy).

extra.pozn: cyngor = advice, and also council; in the south colloquially also Dw i'n moyn… (outside the coursebook); phrase from Robin Radio (p. 116), the sentence is my own

sever.priklad: Dw i isio cyngor am fy nghwsg.
sever.priklad_cs: I want some advice about my sleep (cwsg → [ngh]wsg after fy).

karty.slovo: Dw i'n dihuno tua phum gwaith bob nos
karty.cs: I wake up about five times every night.
karty.priklad: Dw i'n dihuno'n gynnar bob bore.
karty.priklad_cs: I wake up early every morning (cynnar → [g]ynnar after 'n).

extra.pozn: pump → [ph]um after tua; dihuno = to wake up (south); ar ddihun = awake (L2); phrase from Robin Radio (p. 116), own example
